g.text: The VNI keeps overlay networks apart on the same wire
Two overlays share the same hosts, the same UDP 4789 and the same physical links.
Numbers from Docker 29.9.2: ingress = 4096; user overlays 4097, 4098, ... (VNIs are 24-bit, so ~16 million are possible).
This check is why a "frontend" container cannot see "backend" traffic even though both ride the same UDP channel.
